say:5:1810548201:1.text: There, there... Calm down, Hilda. They aren't villains.
say:5:1810548201:1.source_cn: 好了，好了……放松些，希尔达……他们不是恶徒。

say:14:1810548204:0.text: ... Where did you learn that song?
say:14:1810548204:0.source_cn: ……你为什么会唱刚才那首歌谣？

say:15:1810548205:0.text: What's the matter? Do you arrogant living folk think that the Graveborn can only wail in misery?
say:15:1810548205:0.source_cn: 老身会唱什么歌谣与你何干？怎么，自大的混小子以为亡灵只...

say:16:1810548206:0.text: That's an ancient melody from the <style="highlight">Whispering Isles</style>! Only people from there should know it!

say:17:1810548207:0.text: Their native language and songs are forbidden from being shared with outsiders. How do you know it?!
say:17:1810548207:0.source_cn: 按照他们的规矩，本土语言和歌谣都绝不外传，你怎么学会的？

choice_prompt:18:1810548207.text: Their native language and songs are forbidden from being shared with outsiders. How do you know it?!
choice_prompt:18:1810548207.source_cn: 按照他们的规矩，本土语言和歌谣都绝不外传，你怎么学会的？

say:19:1810548208:0.text: Yes. Islands at the edge of the Lightbearer Empire. They're the closest islands to Bantus.
say:19:1810548208:0.source_cn: 嗯。它们位于耀光帝国边陲的海域上，是离班题斯最近的海岛。

say:20:1810548209:0.text: Baden and I traveled there when we were young. We helped the locals fight off Bantus raids.
say:20:1810548209:0.source_cn: 我和巴登年轻时曾前往那里游历，帮助当地人抵御班题斯频繁...

say:21:1810548210:0.text: The language is practically extinct. Even back then, only a handful of elders on the island could still sing that melody.
say:21:1810548210:0.source_cn: 这种语言已经快失传了，当时在本地，也只有极少数老人会唱...

choice:18:1:2.text: Are there really that few people who know it?
choice:18:1:2.source_cn: 会唱这种歌谣的人很少吗？
choice:18:1:2.male: Are there really that few people who know it?
choice:18:1:2.female: Are there really that few people who know it?

say:22:1810548211:0.text: Our teacher, <style="highlight">Bayanu</style>, was one of the few who kept their traditions alive.
say:22:1810548211:0.source_cn: 当时照顾我和巴登的<style=highlight>巴...

say:23:1810548212:0.text: His whole body was <style="highlight">covered in the totems of the Whispering Isles</style>. He only knew a few words of Common, but we learned a lot from him.
say:23:1810548212:0.source_cn: 他<style=highlight>全身都纹着幽声群岛...

say:24:1810548213:1.text: Boy... Are you talking about these tattoos?
say:24:1810548213:1.source_cn: 混小子，你是说这种图腾吗？

say:26:1810548215:1.text: Were you... from the Whispering Isles?
say:26:1810548215:1.source_cn: 你，难道生前是幽声群岛的人？

say:27:1810548216:0.text: No. But the original owner of this left arm probably was. For all I know, it might very well be the old gentleman you spoke of.
say:27:1810548216:0.source_cn: 老身不是，但想来这只左手的原主该是那群岛的土著。搞不好...

That's impossible!!
<shk>How could Bayanu's arm be on you?!</shk>
say:28:1810548217:0.source_cn: 不……这不可能！\n<shk>巴亚茄老师的手臂，怎么可...

say:31:1810548218:0.text: Thane... You might not know this, but when a Graveborn's limb starts to rot or get damaged, it has to be replaced. Sometimes, a new limb brings along memories of its original owner.
say:31:1810548218:0.source_cn: 呃，瑟恩，你应该不知道吧？亡灵的肢体一旦出现腐败损坏的...

say:32:1810548219:0.text: And those limbs usually come from Bantus' army. They have plenty of ways to obtain bodies. And like you said... the Whispering Isles aren't far from them.
say:32:1810548219:0.source_cn: 至于新鲜肢体的来源……一般都是班题斯的军队。他们有很多...

say:38:1810548222:0.text: Young man... Those islands were probably already wiped out by Bantus. They would never show mercy to the living.
say:38:1810548222:0.source_cn: 混小子，你说的那片群岛，怕是早让班题斯荡平了，他们对耀...

say:39:1810548223:0.text: Isn't that exactly why you hate the Graveborn so much?
say:39:1810548223:0.source_cn: 你对亡灵的敌意，不正是因为这个吗？

say:42:1810548224:0.text: Don't jump to conclusions... Maybe it's not the teacher you knew.
say:42:1810548224:0.source_cn: 瑟恩，你别太伤心……也许婆婆的左手不是来自你认识的那位...

say:43:1810548225:0.text: ... No. <style="highlight">This actually explains why Baba Muriel saved you</style>.

say:44:1810548226:0.text: Bayanu treated us like his own grandchildren. And now... his memory lives on through that arm.
say:44:1810548226:0.source_cn: 巴亚茄老师曾像对待孙辈一样关照我们。现在，他的记忆经由...

say:45:1810548227:0.text: Why... why do I suddenly feel so heavy-hearted? Even though I can't remember anything...
say:45:1810548227:0.source_cn: ……为什么……为什么我忽然有点难过？明明我什么都想不起来……

say:46:1810548228:0.text: You don't need memory for feelings. You once told me he felt like another grandfather to you.
say:46:1810548228:0.source_cn: 记忆可以抹除，但感情不能。你曾对我说过，巴亚茄老师就像...

say:55:1810548234:0.source_cn: 那要怎么做才能治好她？有什么我们可以帮上忙的吗？

say:56:1810548235:0.text: We need to <style="highlight">retrieve her keepsake</style>. It holds a remnant of her past power.

say:65:1810548243:0.text: Staying here ensures Baden and Baba Muriel's safety in case the Bantus soldiers take advantage of our absence.
say:65:1810548243:0.source_cn: 你留在这里可以确保巴登和穆婆婆的安全，以防班题斯士兵趁...

say:66:1810548244:0.text: Especially that assassin. She's bound to return. Your agility gives you the best chance against her.
say:66:1810548244:0.source_cn: 尤其是那个刺客，她一定会再来。你的身手更为灵活，对付她...

say:67:1810548245:0.source_cn: ……好，那我就守在这。你们快去快回，别让我们三个担心。
